You control a basic land.

description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping any other creature you control, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the tapped creature, targeting Jared and putting a +1/+1 counter on Jared.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
